pages.title: Canyon
pages.description: city in Randall County, Texas, United States
pages.extract: Canyon is a city in the High Plains region of the Texas Panhandle. It is home to the West Texas branch of Texas A&M University, the most prestigious in the region, and is the gateway city to Palo Duro Canyon.

pages.title: Charlottesville
pages.description: independent city in Virginia, United States
pages.extract: Charlottesville, in central Virginia, is a lovely university town of about 40,000 with lots to offer. Charlottesville is a town steeped in history and culture.  Charlottesville is a major cultural center for central Virginia, and features more fine dining, shopping, and entertainment than one might expect for a town of its size. Ensconced in beautiful Albemarle County, Charlottesville is also surrounded by vineyards and horse country.

pages.title: Diving the Cape Peninsula and False Bay/Klein Pannekoek

pages.title: Honduras
pages.description: sovereign state in Central America
pages.extract:
Honduras has colonial villages (Gracias, Comayagua), ancient Maya ruins (Copán), natural parks (Moskitia), and a Pacific and Caribbean coastline and the Bay Islands, with great beaches and coral reefs where snorkeling and diving are exceptional by any standard.
The second-biggest country in Central America, Honduras presents a variety of travel. Good amenities can be found in cities like Tegucigalpa, San Pedro Sula, La Ceiba, Tela, Utila, Roatán and Copán Ruinas, but elsewhere conditions can be basic, especially in the rural areas.
You can find good hotels even in small towns if you are willing to pay a bit more (Honduras is relatively inexpensive). Nevertheless a visit is worthwhile, especially to the ancient Maya ruins in Copán, the colonial towns of Gracias and Comayagua, and the Caribbean Coast.

pages.title: Las Vegas
pages.description: seat of Clark County, and largest city in state of Nevada, United States
pages.extract: In the midst of the southern Nevada desert, Las Vegas is the largest city in the state of Nevada. Nicknamed Sin City, Las Vegas and its surrounding communities are famed for their mega-casino resorts, often lavishly decorated with names and themes meant to evoke romance, mystery, and exotic destinations. Along the brightly-lit Strip through the center of the city, visitors will find all manner of amusements and entertainment: circuses, stage shows, thrill rides, erotica, exotic animals, fine dining restaurants, nightclubs, shopping, and elaborate fountain displays, to say nothing of the age-old allure of gambling and drinking.

pages.extract: Now that Serbia is greatly diminished from its historical boundaries, Podrinje is the most westerly region of the modern Republic of Serbia and abuts both Bosnia Herzogovina and Montenegro.

pages.title: Santaquin
pages.description: city in Utah County, Utah, United States
pages.extract: Santaquin is a small town in the Wasatch Range region in the state of Utah in the United States. It hugs the bottom of Utah Valley and is generally considered the southernmost city in the Wasatch Range. Santaquin has a population of approximately 11,000 as of 2017.

pages.title: Taunton (England)
pages.description: town and civil parish in Somerset, England
pages.extract: Taunton is the county town of Somerset, a county in the south-west of England. Taunton has several landmarks room its thousand-year history, and is famous for its cider.

pages.extract: Thargomindah is a town in the southwest of Outback Queensland.

pages.title: Wailuku
pages.description: census-designated place in Maui County, Hawaiʻi, United States
pages.extract: Wailuku, on Maui, is the seat of Maui County.  Unlike the commercial center of Kahului, Wailuku has a small-town plantation feel centered around its Main Street.  Several buildings in Wailuku are registered as historic places.  It is also the gateway to nearby Iao Valley and Iao Needle.

pages.title: Western Kenya
pages.description: region of Kenya
pages.extract:
Western Kenya is a region of Kenya and includes Nyanza and Western provinces of the same name.
Although the region has much to offer in terms of landscape and culture, it has played a relatively minor role in tourism to date. It is often used as a transit area en route to Uganda. Thanks to its strong agricultural character, it is of particular interest to travellers who want to venture off the beaten track.

pages.title: Wolfville

pages.extract: Wolfville is a town of 4,200 people (2016) in the region of Annapolis Valley, Nova Scotia. It lies on the Bay of Fundy. It is home to Acadia University.

pages.title: La Pobla de Lillet
pages.description: municipality in Catalonia, Spain
pages.extract: La Pobla de Lillet is a small town in Berguedà County, in the north of the Barcelona Province, Catalonia. It is best known for the Artigas Gardens, designed by Antoni Gaudí, and for a narrow-gauge tourist railway that runs through the valley.
